name: Audio Output Recorder
author: Brett
description: Records everything the phone plays while it is on (AudioPlaybackCapture, never the microphone), in timestamped 30-minute chunks sent to axHub; each chunk stays on the phone until axHub confirms it, queued and retried while offline, within a small local cap. One switch in AmberX plus a quick-settings tile; Android asks for consent every start and shows a notification while recording. Calls and apps that block capture can't be recorded. The recordings list (play, share, delete, send to Audio Extract) shows in AmberX and on the console.
